_schema._about: Copy and camera data for the home hero (CONTRACT §7). Every string here is visible copy; keep British English, sentence case, no 'studio', no client claims.
_schema.trust:
string. The 36px display paragraph on the first frame (Lance: 18 words / 132 chars). Words stagger in by the engine; render as one

and let the engine split words.
_schema.walkHint: string. Bottom-right hint in the trust layer, next to the .hero-walk arrow.
_schema.skip: string. The small link bottom-right of the HUD that jumps to the end of the pin.
_schema.video: {src, poster, ariaLabel}. Root-relative paths with a leading slash, used as-is.
_schema.stops: array[5] in camera order. {id: matches the drawing group suffix exactly ('1-front-of-house' → detail group id '#1-front-of-house', fade group '#1-fade'); label: HUD list button text; title: HUD card title (26px display); description: HUD card body (14px, Lance 10–17 words); panel: src/panels/<panel>.html name per CONTRACT §9; bbox: {x,y,w,h} of the room slot in SVG units (CONTRACT §8); camera: {cx, cy, w} = bbox centre and bbox.w × 1.25 in SVG units — the engine derives h = w / stageAspect}.
_schema.metrics: {eyebrow, title, sub, items[3]}. eyebrow is intentionally empty: Lance renders no eyebrow above 'Measured in Outcomes' (ref/shots/s22) — render only if non-empty. title = 42px display; sub = 16px grey (Lance 7 words). items: {value: the big numeral; unit: the superscript where Lance has '%'; label: the 16px line under it (Lance 4–8 words)}. Commitments, never results (CONTRACT §10).
_schema.marquee: {ariaLabel, items[6]: {name, file, alt}}. The six placements hypjam ships to (CONTRACT §10). file = monochrome typographic wordmark SVGs drawn by us, opacity .5, path relative to site root; they do not exist yet — the assets/marquee agent creates them at exactly these paths.
_schema.reducedMotion: string. Alternative to walkHint when prefers-reduced-motion is set (the camera jumps between stops instead of scrubbing).
